purpose: Track how each story area can become a complete 78-card tarot deck while preserving MythCards card identity.

closed_city.tracker_scope_note: This tracker began with Closed City but is currently acting as the Russian tarot master planning area until separate 26-card trackers are created for Closed City, Far North, and Winter Front / Army Era.
closed_city.deck_style: Soviet occult-science tarot built from reactor rooms, signal arrays, dream monitors, military containment, hidden patronage, redacted evidence, and the first physical cards.

suit_style.Wands: signal rods, warning lights, authority badges, reactor flame
suit_style.Cups: dream monitors, sleep-lab vessels, signal water, intimate confessions
suit_style.Swords: containment blades, redacted files, command orders, diagnostic truth
suit_style.Pentacles: reactor parts, keys, helmets, notebooks, industrial relics

russian_sub_areas.role: 1980s-era science and industrial setting with nuclear power, leaks, cosmonaut programs, remote viewing, dream work, and the first convergence incident.
Remote northern Russia with survival folklore, old rites, aurora/ice mysticism, animal power, healing, the tiger, gymnast, Frost Seer, and Nadia Belaya.
russian_sub_areas.note: Nadia Belaya belongs to this sub-area even though she is temporarily tracked in the Russian tarot mapping as The Star.

russian_sub_areas.role: World War II-era and older army setting with command, snipers, engineers, battlefield endurance, sacrifice, and national mythic memory.

sub_area_deck_model.tarot_deck_note: A complete Russian physical tarot deck can be built from three 26-card Russian sub-areas, giving 78 MythCards/tarot representatives without forcing Closed City alone to fill every tarot archetype.

relics: Cosmonaut Helmet With A Second Shadow
defined_but_not_yet_tarot_mapped: Cosmonaut Helmet With A Second Shadow

original_russian_prototype_cards.note: These earlier prototype cards remain part of the planning inventory. Some have been expanded or replaced by richer review-draft versions; Far North and Winter Front cards should eventually move into their own 26-card sub-area trackers.

narrative_support_cards.name: Colonel Viktor Semyonov
narrative_support_cards.role: Narrative/bonus command figure who documents the containment authority. He is not the primary Closed City Leader card; that role belongs to Irina Vasilievna Karpova.

cross_sub_area_tarot_placeholders.name: Nadia Belaya
cross_sub_area_tarot_placeholders.note: Keep her mapped in the Russian tarot plan, but do not count her as a Closed City character.

current_mappings.reason: The ordinary worker steps through sealed routes first, not because he is chosen by doctrine, but because someone must move.
Orlov stands at the conversion point where data, symbol, reactor force, and dream become usable power.
Elena guards the threshold between measured science and hidden dream knowledge.
Karpova is wealth, patronage, appetite, comfort, and control made politically fertile.

current_mappings.set_count_role: Narrative support / bonus; does not replace the primary Closed City Leader card and should not be counted against the standard 10-character Closed City sub-area target unless promoted later.
current_mappings.reason: Semyonov is visible order, military containment, and the architecture of command.
Keep open for now. The best fit may be a future doctrine, institution, containment protocol, or sanctioned occult-science card rather than an existing character.
The event centers choice, desire, divided loyalty, and the emotional wound between Elena, Orlov, Yuri, and the breach.
VERA-7 is directed movement through impossible corridors and disciplined transport under pressure.
Yuri's strength is not only armor; it is restraint under desire, fear, and containment duty.
Keep open for now. Zoya has some Hermit signal-carrier qualities, but her core energy may fit Moon, Devil, Cups, or another dream/desire archetype better.
Reality turns suddenly and briefly, changing paths, fate, and position.
Keep open for now. Redacted Incident Tape and Anya Lebedev are possible candidates, but Justice should represent evidence, truth, and accountability rather than official state law.
Keep open for now. A future Orlov coma-gate event such as The Coma Gate Opens may become the best fit, but Orlov's primary character mapping is already The Magician.
Keep open for now. Elena Missing In The Signal and Closed City Incident are already stronger as The Lovers and The Tower; Death should wait for a more exact irreversible-transformation card.
Keep open for now. Dream Monitors Synchronize and Lead-Sealed Notebook have partial fit, but Temperance should represent controlled integration or careful alchemical mixing once that card exists.
The key turns access, permission, desire, and dependence into a beautiful trap. It represents power that opens doors while binding people to Karpova's system.
The reactor opening inward is the area's Tower: catastrophic revelation, collapse of false structure, and divine/occult rupture.

current_mappings.set_count_role: Far North character; temporarily tracked in the Russian tarot plan and should not be counted as a Closed City character.
current_mappings.reason: Nadia Belaya is the Far North Mystic healer whose innocent mercy becomes proof that the breach does not only take; she saves someone after convergence exposure and gives the Russian arc its living image of hope.

candidate_concept.narrative_role: A northern healer who understands old cold-water rites, survival medicine, and the spiritual cost of keeping someone alive after convergence exposure.
candidate_concept.tarot_fit: The Star as healing after catastrophe, a living sign that the Russian arc contains mercy as well as secrecy and containment.
catch_phrases: I do not ask the wound what it deserves.
I listen for the light still breathing under the ice.
Come back. The dark has held you long enough.

current_mappings.reason: Zoya embodies the Closed City's dream-shadow: desire, illusion, psychic distortion, hidden memory, and the dangerous pull of what Orlov thinks he understands.
current_mappings.art_note: Corrected variant keeps the Closed City lab functional and humid rather than literally flooded; Moon symbolism comes from fogged glass, CRT crescents, lunar light, reflections, and hidden observer silhouettes.

current_mappings.reason: A terrible inner sun gives power at a cost and exposes the body's vulnerability to light.

Keep open for a later Russian sub-area event where hidden witnesses, dead signals, buried experiments, or other realities answer the call. Semyonov Orders Silence is better held as a suppression/control card rather than the final reckoning.

The first physical MythCards artifact turns the convergence from dream and machinery into a complete object that can pass between worlds; it closes the first Closed City loop and opens the larger game reality.
A small physical relic becomes the seed of material and mystical control.
current_mappings.art_note: Corrected variant keeps the Chintamani fragment sealed inside the evidence container, with the tag and cord attached outside the latch/seal rather than passing through the glass.

current_mappings.reason: The sealed reactor shard turns material power into a balancing act: useful danger, Leak exposure, and unstable advantage held under pressure.
Three subjects, three monitors, and the lab team become one working occult-science structure: specialized craft, collaboration, and systems-thinking turning into contamination.
The notebook turns discovery into guarded possession: classified knowledge sealed away, owned, feared, and used to extend the reach of those who control it.
Semyonov's order turns hardship into institutional exclusion: witnesses are locked out of aid, truth, and resources while the state controls who is allowed inside the warmth of certainty.
Keep open for a Closed City card more directly about rationed resources, controlled aid, debt, patronage, or unequal distribution of material support.
The tape is young, dangerous evidence: surveillance, investigation, nervous truth, and a message that changes when watched. It fits Page of Swords better than a material exchange card.

flood_survivors.deck_style: Drowned Atlantean and Egyptian mystery tarot built from black water, ley stones, sealed vaults, memory rites, the Emerald Tablet, the Black Sarcophagus, hidden bloodlines, angelic judgment, and forbidden survivor truth.

suit_style.Wands: ley-staffs, living causeways, royal command, serpent routes
suit_style.Cups: black water, memory bowls, burial rites, drowned love
suit_style.Swords: tomb oaths, erased names, judgment, guarded truth
suit_style.Pentacles: basalt stones, tablets, sarcophagi, vault instruments, pearls

current_mappings.mythcards_card: Stone-Line Laborer / Menka of the Lower Causeway
current_mappings.reason: Menka is the ordinary worker who opens forbidden routes toward an unknown future.
The Emerald Tablet is the preserved formula by which above and below, Atlantis and Egypt, symbol and matter reflect one another.

current_mappings.mythcards_card: Thalassa-Nekh, Vessel of the Drowned Seraph
current_mappings.reason: She is hidden spiritual knowledge embodied, and not all of that knowledge is human.

current_mappings.mythcards_card: Queen Meret-Anu, Keeper of the Buried Tide
current_mappings.reason: She is preservation, bloodline, sovereignty, and controlled fertility after catastrophe.
Ahesu turns will, rider, and route into motion through living stone and black water.
Naia's ferocity is bound to restraint, oath, grief, and the courage to face the sealed dead.
He carries a lonely inner light made from memories no society wants to face.
The entity delivers judgment beyond royal editing or survivor convenience.
The sarcophagus is death, transformation, forbidden remains, and the unsealing of what must change.

current_mappings.mythcards_card: The Name Was Cut From Stone
current_mappings.reason: A false monument breaks when the erased name returns.
The reflecting water reveals hidden fear, buried memory, and unstable truth.
The survivors carry the old world into the next one, completing one cycle and beginning another.

current_mappings.mythcards_card: Iset-Nara, Architect of the Hidden Vault
current_mappings.reason: She represents sacred craft, design, collaboration, and stonework as hidden knowledge.
A first stirring of living route-energy and dangerous forward motion.

next_steps: Decide whether a game card can appear in both the playable game set and a physical tarot deck, or whether tarot deck cards are separate premium art variants.
Create one 26-card tracker per sub-area as the art catalog grows, starting with Russian Closed City, Far North, and Winter Front / Army Era.
Before inventing a new tarot-specific card, check the defined card inventory for unmapped original prototype cards and review-draft cards.
Audit existing Closed City, Far North, Winter Front, and Flood Survivor artwork against the proposed tarot mappings.
Fill missing Major Arcana first, then Minor Arcana suit by suit.
When generating new art, include the tarot archetype in the art prompt as a compositional constraint.
